name: meeem
description: Build and edit hosted websites, web apps and browser games with Meeem. Check your plan, Build Credits and saved-app allowance, inspect your projects and track build progress. Choose Quick for a standard build or explicitly request Studio. Hosted links are accessible to anyone with the link. Community-feed publication is a separate action. A Meeem account is required.
